title: Terminal
description:
The terminal location at which the containers are loaded onto and discharged from the barge.
Please refer to Reference Data API '[Get terminals](#operation/_08_getTerminals)' to resolve a valid Terminal and its attributes

shortName.description: Code issued by Portbase to identify the Terminal organisation.

ean.description: European Article Numbering issued by Secure Logistics to identify the Terminal organisation.

bicsCode.description: Terminal code according to the Terminal code table of Binnenvaart Informatie- en Communicatie Systeem managed by Rijkswaterstaat.

quayName.description: The name of the quay where a vessel can moor for loading, unloading or e.g. awaiting orders.

smdgCode.description: Terminal facility code according to the Shipplanning Message Development Group.

tarRequired.description: Only relevant for road. Indicates whether the terminal uses TAR codes or not.

roadStatusRequestAllowed.description: Only relevant for road. Indicates whether the terminal can process road status requests.

bargeStatusRequestForbidden.description: Only relevant for barge. Indicates whether the terminal can process barge status requests. Default is false.

cutoffPeriod.description: Only relevant for rail. Indicates the cutoff period for the train composition upload (relative to the eta) for this terminal.

quaySelectByDeclarantForbidden.description: Indicates whether the terminal can be used by the Declarant to send a visit declaration. Some terminals can only be selected by the terminal organisation or Nextlogic, if so this option is set to true.

updateAllowed.description: Indicates whether the terminal allows updates on pre-notifications, only for *barge*. Status requests can always be updated. Deprecated, use the handlingUpdateForbidden setting to see for which modality updates are forbidden

handlingUpdateForbidden.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support updates on pre-notifications. When this list contains a modality, updates are not supported for this terminal for that modality only. Status requests can always be updated.

items.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support updates on pre-notifications. When this list contains a modality, updates are not supported for this terminal for that modality only. Status requests can always be updated.

handlingUpdateBypassAllowed.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support standard updates on pre-notifications, but allows the update bypass whereby a handling is first cancelled at the terminal and then declared as a new pre-notification.

items.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support standard updates on pre-notifications, but allows the update bypass whereby a handling is first cancelled at the terminal and then declared as a new pre-notification.

handlingMoveBypassAllowed.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support standard updates on pre-notifications, but allows the update bypass for MoveHandlings only. Update bypass means that a handling is first cancelled at the terminal and then declared as a new pre-notification.

items.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not support standard updates on pre-notifications, but allows the update bypass for MoveHandlings only. Update bypass means that a handling is first cancelled at the terminal and then declared as a new pre-notification.

maxSealNumberLength.description: Maximum length of the seal number.

acceptAfterRejectForbidden.description: Indicates whether the terminal does not allow a handling accept after a handling reject.

terminalSettings.description: Terminal settings restricting handling declarations depending on the type of declaration.

nextlogicParticipant.description: Setting that indicates this terminal is a Nextlogic Integral Planning participant.

prenotificationRestrictedToDeclarants.description: List of declarants per modality for which declaration declaring handlings is allowed. When there is no list for a modality all declarants are allowed, otherwise it is restricted to this list of declarant shortnames.

additionalProperties.description: List of declarants per modality for which declaration declaring handlings is allowed. When there is no list for a modality all declarants are allowed, otherwise it is restricted to this list of declarant shortnames.

items.description: List of declarants per modality for which declaration declaring handlings is allowed. When there is no list for a modality all declarants are allowed, otherwise it is restricted to this list of declarant shortnames.

allOf.description: List of declarants per modality for which declaration declaring handlings is allowed. When there is no list for a modality all declarants are allowed, otherwise it is restricted to this list of declarant shortnames.

autoRejectEnabled.description: Indicates whether non-green handlings are rejected automatically after visit closing.

handlingUpdateBypassAllowed.description: Indicates whether updates are allowed for handlings after load-discharge-list is reopend or sent before cargo cutoff.

LoadDischargeListSettings.description: The settings for the configuration of the load-discharge-list.

locationUnCode.description: UN/LOCODE; the United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations of the location

Location.description: Use a location retrieved with find locations via the Reference Data API wiht the operation [findLocations](#operation/_05_findLocations).

loading.description: Does the setting apply to loading or discharge.

full.description: Does the setting apply to full or empty.

modality.description: Does the setting apply to rail, road or barge.

cargoCutOffInMinutes.description: The minimum amount of time (in minutes) before visit arrival when operators are still allowed to submit changes to the cargo list.

lossenOpRichtlijnAllowed.description: Are equipment numbers optional for empty discharge handlings.

TerminalSettings.description: Contains restrictions on handling declarations, depending on the type of declaration.
